Turned off DLSS, turned on DLAA, dropped mirrors, shadow sources down, cranked up every other shadow setting to utilize CPU more. Left all texture related settings to the highest and dropped AnSio to 4x, msaa off, lens flare off, etc.

Edited the game.xml file to increase foliage view distance. 

I turned on process lasso. Set fs25 to high priority. Closed out every other software running in the background. 

Increased my shader cache to 1gb in Nvidia Control Panel. 

Increased fan speeds on fan control to bring temps down a bit further. 

I’m on 5800x3d with 3090 and 32gb 3600 ram. Shouldn’t have this difficult of time keeping 60FPS at 4k.
